stepTitle: The Crab Nebula pulsar is the remnant of a supernova that occurred in A.D. $$1054$$. If we know that the initial supernova had a power of $$5\times10**{37}\,\text{W}$$ and it currently outputs a power of $$10**{28}\,\text{W},$$ calculate the approximate ratio of the current power to the initial power.
